message: Can you look at this ECG? I think it's normal, right?
reply:
**I wouldn’t call this ECG completely normal.** My reading from the image is:

- A regular sinus rhythm at about **65–70 beats/minute**.
- A pattern suggesting **right bundle branch block (RBBB)**—a delay in electrical conduction through the right side of the heart—with associated changes in V1–V2. This needs confirmation using the original tracing and measured QRS duration. [ECG criteria](https://www.jacc.org/doi/10.1016/j.jacc.2008.12.013)

RBBB can be an incidental, longstanding finding, but whether it needs further investigation depends on symptoms, previous ECGs, and medical history. **Have a clinician review it and compare it with any older ECG.** A photo alone cannot establish that everything is otherwise normal or rule out a heart attack.

If you currently have **chest pain, shortness of breath, fainting, or severe dizziness, seek emergency care now**.

What prompted the ECG, how old are you, and do you have any symptoms?
